hero.label: A LITTLE CLOSER TO THE MUSIC
hero.title: Every word.
hero.subtitle: Right on time.
hero.description: Turn the songs you love into beautifully synced lyrics. Find the beat, fine-tune every line, and share it with the world.
hero.note: Free to use · No account required

overview.label: NOT JUST ANOTHER TEXT EDITOR
overview.description: Hunting timestamps line by line is tedious. Lyrike Studio works with the audio itself — waveform visualization, region-based editing, and tap-to-sync — so LRCLIB contributors and karaoke makers can feel the rhythm instead of guessing.

journey.label: HOW IT WORKS
journey.screenshotAlt: Lyrike Studio editor with a loaded track, waveform timeline and synced lyrics

steps.title: Paste a YouTube link
steps.description: Drop the URL in. We fetch the metadata, cache the audio, and build the waveform.

steps.title: Auto-transcribe
steps.description: Let the transcription service generate timed lyrics for you — or start from plain text.

steps.title: Tap to sync
steps.description: Play the track and hit the T key to stamp each line right on the beat.

steps.title: Fine-tune on the waveform
steps.description: Drag and resize regions to line everything up — down to word-level karaoke timing.

steps.title: Export or publish
steps.description: Download a standard .lrc file — or publish it straight to LRCLIB.

finalCta.title: Ready to sync?
finalCta.description: No account needed. No install. Just paste & go.

footer.tagline: A place for every word in the music.
